errors.text_span: Jeder Balken ist in zwei Farben unterteilt: dunkelblau für "Entlastete" und hellblau für "Belastete".
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart, not a stacked or subdivided one. Each category on the x-axis has two separate, side-by-side bars (one dark blue, one light blue), not a single bar divided into two colored sections.
